subject.title: feat: add session stream mode command

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a shared persisted per-session `/stream` override and public channel capability across Telegram, Discord, and Slack?
rationale: This is a new user-facing command and durable preference, not a defined bug fix; it creates a plugin contract and changes channel delivery behavior, while the linked issue is already marked as needing a maintainer product decision.

options.title: Approve shared command
options.body: Keep the cross-channel persisted design, repair the two correctness defects, rebase, and require live proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the first version
options.body: Limit channel or persistence scope until usage and contract shape are proven, then expand through the same capability seam.

options.title: Decline session overrides
options.body: Keep preview streaming as static channel configuration and close the linked issue and this PR with the supported alternative.

recommendation.title: Approve shared command
recommendation.body: Keep the cross-channel persisted design, repair the two correctness defects, rebase, and require live proof before merge.
